context.transcript:
Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the Montreal Theater.
My name is Marie Clement.
On behalf of our local Young Performing Artists Coalition, it is an honor to host the performance of the original play titled The Three Doors.
First, congratulations to the students performing tonight.
They have worked long hours rehearsing to master their roles for you.
I ask that you now put any devices into the studio. the studio.
You are in for a wonderful evening watching stars in the making.
context.transcript_translation:
大家晚上好，欢迎来到蒙特利尔剧院。
我的名字是 Marie Clement。
我代表我们当地的 Young Performing Artists Coalition，很荣幸能举办这部名为 The Three Doors 的原创戏剧表演。
首先，祝贺今晚表演的学生们。
他们付出了许多时间进行排练，以掌握他们的角色献给您。
我要求大家现在将任何设备放入工作室。the studio。
你们即将度过一个观看未来明星的精彩夜晚。
